entities.summary: King David Dunlap V is an American former professional football player who was an offensive tackle in the National Football League (NFL). He played college football for the Auburn Tigers, and was selected by the Philadelphia Eagles in the seventh round of the 2008 NFL draft. He also played for the San Diego Chargers.
